Two quote timestamps failed the deterministic check and must be corrected: (1) script_coverage[11] 'So I'll get you scheduled for 05:30 on Friday, which is the first.' is actually at 01:21, not 00:55 (00:55 is the rep listing open Friday slots). (2) script_coverage[12] customer quote 'That's fine. Thank you.' occurs around 02:05-02:09 embedded in the rep's closing turn, not at 01:26 (01:26 is the rep saying 'Just to let you know, we'll give you a call'). Fix both timestamps on rerun.

Additional targeted fixes: (a) Resolve the appointment_channel field — the transcript line at 00:35 ('I'm just looking for a better day to bring it by') strongly signals an in-person visit, not phone; 'unclear' is not the best-supported read and should be updated with this evidence cited. (b) Reconcile the tension between rep_intent's 'minimal-effort' characterization of the bill deferral and cherry_pick_moments' more charitable alternative_hypothesis for the same moment — pick one primary read and note the other as considered-and-rejected, rather than asserting both without resolution. (c) Correct the schema reference for the day/time confusion at 00:42 — protocols.time_constraint is about call-duration anxiety, not day-of-week confusion; either drop the schema citation or note no clean section applies. (d) Update the co-decider coaching point to cite protocols.adult_child_decision_maker directly instead of analogizing from protocols.spouse_decision, since the former is the schema section built for exactly this scenario. (e) Remove or caveat the unsupported claim that this is a 'paid lead' benefiting from 'Ion's paid-lead flexibility' in trajectory_verdict — lead_type is not established anywhere in this call's transcript. (f) Consider adding the 00:35 'bring it by' line and the 01:12 schedule-fit check as additional cherry_pick/positive entries, as noted in missed_moments.
